mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate level relative to its historical average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous deceleration in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) and increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which precedes economic slowdown and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and rising), elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized) signals potential economic overheating and policy overreach, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in industrial production growth below 0.5% signals a weakening supply chain and economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO YoY growth < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales above its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS as predictor of 60-day SPX returns remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.5% signals weak economic demand and impending recession, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.5%.
